title: Some vesting recipients temporarily won't be able to claim
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as funds will be locked for 30 days  **Likelihood:** Medium, because it will only happen when the cliff is < 30 day  ## Description  The `SLICE_PERIOD` constant in `Vesting` is set to 30 days. Due to the following math in `_computeReleasableAmount`  ```solidity uint256 vestedSeconds = (timeFromStart / SLICE_PERIOD) * SLICE_PERIOD; ```  If `timeFromStart` is less than 30 days this will round down to zero, which means the amount to claim until 30 days have passed will always be zero.
